concept.prompt: Create a single production art-direction concept for KANNON ARENA, an original premium third-person no-build competitive shooter played by a father, son and friends on phones and desktop. Graphics are the priority, aim for the polish, cohesion and readability of a top-tier contemporary shooter. Render as a believable live 3D gameplay screen, wide 16:9 landscape 1920x1080. Art direction SUNBREAK: a beautiful elevated Mediterranean coastal research outpost, weathered warm ivory limestone and pale sandstone architecture with deep petrol-teal steel insets, copper details, restrained safety-orange accents, realistic PBR materials, rounded bevels, fine joints, modest cracks and clear dark recesses. Rich golden afternoon sunlight, soft contact shadows, bright turquoise sea, rugged stratified cliffs and a recognizable graceful coastal observatory tower in the distance. Mature umbrella pines and tall cypresses on exterior terraces, individual leafy silhouettes, some purple flowers. A convincing inhabited architectural place with tactical cover and clear readable movement routes, not a flat empty tiled test pad. The layout is a 64m square playable terrace: left and right low structures, two waist-high central cover blocks, a genuine wide gate between two stone towers toward the far north, a raised stepped terrace toward the south. Keep center combat lanes uncluttered. Foreground left-of-center: full-body original athletic adult armored scout viewed from behind in over-the-right-shoulder camera, natural human proportions, carefully contoured ivory ceramic chest/shoulder/forearm/shin armor over charcoal technical fabric, teal backpack panel, tasteful amber and teal accents, reflective dark visor, integrated small back equipment, well-modeled hands and boots. Holding a plausible original AR correctly with both hands, ready movement stance. Another rival small in middle distance, clean readable silhouette. Character detail must look professionally modeled and rigged, never cuboid limbs, toy robot or generic soldier. Physically plausible material response, foliage depth, restrained atmospheric haze, crisp focus, beautiful environment composition with enough negative space for aiming. Match the existing HUD visual identity minimally: dark navy translucent straight-edged panels, athletic condensed cream typography and chartreuse active slot. Top center '0 / 15' and '04:58'; upper left small health and shield bars marked 100 and 50; bottom right three compact slots labelled '1 AR', '2 SHOTGUN', '3 HEAL x2' with native-looking simple white icons, first slot chartreuse. Tiny clean crosshair in center. No other text, no website or promotional framing, no battle royale storm, no building, no gore, no familiar franchise characters or logos. All world imagery is a direction for optimized real-time 3D assets, with coherent materials and deliberately authored geometry. Avoid comic outline/cel shading, uniform flat surfaces, repetitive grey cubes, flat foliage balls, oversized head or hands, oversaturated neon glow, fake menus, excessive UI or impossible cinematic depth of field.

materials.prompt: Use the attached image only as the material/art-direction reference. Create a production-ready seamless tileable PBR BASE COLOR texture for the pale warm ivory quarried limestone architecture in this coastal observatory game. A flat orthographic square 2048x2048 material scan, no perspective, no scene, no objects, no text. Fine stone grain, natural cream/sand mineral variations, restrained weathering, sparse small hairline cracks, fine salt/wear near pores, subtly varied surface. Sophisticated realistic AAA-quality albedo detail at human scale. Uniform diffuse neutral lighting, absolutely no directional lighting, cast shadows, highlights, shiny reflections or ambient vignette baked into the color. No large blocks or mortar grid; the architecture geometry supplies slab divisions. All four edges tile flawlessly with continuous detail and no seam or border. Keep contrast restrained and bright ivory like the reference, not orange, grey concrete, speckled granite, blurry clouds or cartoon texture. This is a usable visible production material map, not a labeled material sheet or 3D preview.

A refined staggered pattern of broad cut rectangular light cream and warm sandstone slabs, about 60x90cm each, narrow subtle dark mortar gaps, slightly chipped edges, soft rubbed wear, small naturally irregular mineral pores and occasional hairline cracks. Natural realistic high-end game scanned-material quality, broad tonal slab variation without noisy patchwork. Muted warm ivory/taupe color as in reference; beautiful detailed but readable.
